Final categorization: OK  
(Justification: The paper is a non-review research article that explicitly implements national-scale (Colombia-wide) spatial modeling of land use/land cover (LULC) change—specifically deforestation—using the Dinamica EGO platform. Its primary objective is to model and predict future deforestation under two distinct quantitative scenarios: Business-as-Usual (BAU) and Governance (GOV), with projections to 2030 and 2050. The study uses spatially explicit drivers, produces mapped deforestation projections, and includes quantitative analysis of driver importance and regional variation. Although accuracy metrics like Kappa or AUC are not detailed in the provided excerpt, the methodology relies on established spatial modeling practices with calibrated transition rules based on empirical forest loss data (Hansen dataset), and results include quantified outcomes (e.g., forest loss area, fragmentation impacts). All core inclusion criteria are met: national scale, primary focus on LULC prediction, ≥2 future scenarios, spatially explicit modeling, and mapped outputs. None of the exclusion criteria apply.)
